PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # differential pair width (um)
    "W_tail": (4.0, 1.5, 10.0),   # clocked tail switch width
    "W_ln":   (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),    # latch NMOS width
    "W_lp":   (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),    # latch PMOS width
    "W_rst":  (0.84, 0.42, 2.0),  # reset PMOS width (4 switches)
    "W_invn": (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),  # output buffer NMOS width
    "W_invp": (1.68, 0.42, 6.0),  # output buffer PMOS width
    "L":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),  # channel length of core devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = p["L"]
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vdd = 1.8

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch (clk high = evaluate)
    n.M("Mtail", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    # diff pair: vinp side discharges dip -> xa falls -> outp rises
    n.M("Min1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("Min2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("Mln1", "xa", "xb", "dip", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("Mln2", "xb", "xa", "din", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("Mlp1", "xa", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    n.M("Mlp2", "xb", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low = precharge internal nodes to VDD)
    n.M("Mr1", "xa",  "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mr2", "xb",  "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mr3", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mr4", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], 0.15)
    # output buffers: precharge -> xa=xb=VDD -> outp=outn=0
    n.M("Mon1", "outp", "xa", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mop1", "outp", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mon2", "outn", "xb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mop2", "outn", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox = 8.5e-15          # F/um^2
    cov = 0.3e-15          # overlap per um width (approx)
    def cg(W, Lx=L): return W * Lx * cox + 2 * W * cov
    c_x = (cg(p["W_ln"]) + cg(p["W_lp"]) + cg(p["W_invn"], 0.15) + cg(p["W_invp"], 0.15)
           + (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_rst"]) * 1.0e-15)
    c_d = (p["W_in"] + p["W_ln"] + p["W_rst"]) * 1.0e-15
    c_tail = (2 * p["W_in"] + p["W_tail"]) * 1.0e-15
    c_clk = cg(p["W_tail"]) + 4 * cg(p["W_rst"], 0.15)
    c_sw = 2 * c_d + 1.5 * c_x + cl + cg(p["W_invn"], 0.15) * 0.5 + c_clk + c_tail
    energy = c_sw * vdd**2

    on = lut.op("n", p["W_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    opl = lut.op("p", p["W_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = on["gm"] + opl["gm"]
    dp = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], L, 0.75, 0.6)
    t_int = c_d * 0.5 / max(dp["Id"], 1e-6)
    av = max(dp["gm"] * t_int / c_d, 1.0)
    t_lat = (c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-6)) * math.log(max(vdd / 2 / (av * dv), 1.0))
    t_out = (cl + c_x) * vdd / 2 / max(lut.op("p", p["W_invp"], 0.15, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"], 1e-6)
    delay = 30e-12 + t_int + t_lat + t_out

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
